column1: # Admin1 name overrides: GeoNames admin1 code -> seeded state space name.
# Used when the GeoNames admin1 name differs from the seeded state name
# admin1_codes.tsv, so the GeoNames name never reaches name-matching for
# Format: <country ISO2>\t<geonames admin1 code>\t<seeded state name>
# Nigeria — GeoNames names FCT "FCT"; seeded state is "Federal Capital Territory".
# Indonesia — seeded states use Indonesian names (and island-level parents
# like 'Jawa'/'Sumatera' exist); GeoNames uses English ("West Java").
# Ukraine — seeded states use transliterated adjectival forms ("Donetska")
# vs GeoNames "Donetsk". UA.13 pinned to Kyivska explicitly: its GeoNames
# name "Kyiv Oblast" would otherwise token-match the 'Kyiv' city state.
# Russia — GeoNames uses anglicised/transliterated names that differ from
# Ethiopia — regional-state naming differs. (ET.55 Central Ethiopia and
# ET.56 South Ethiopia are 2023-era regions with no seeded counterpart —
# Mexico — GeoNames "Mexico" is the STATE (Estado de México), "Mexico City"
# Madagascar — seeded states are the six former provinces; GeoNames admin1
# uses the 23 regions. Regions map cleanly into their containing province.
# France — GeoNames uses anglicised region names.
# Czechia — GeoNames regions vs seeded kraj names.
# South Korea — GeoNames "-do" suffixed Korean names vs seeded English.
# Taiwan — GeoNames "Takao" is the historic name for Kaohsiung.
# Colombia — "Department" suffix collisions with a same-rooted sibling
# Sweden — GeoNames uses ae/oe digraph transliterations for å/ä/ö.
# Poland — GeoNames voivodeship names vs seeded English forms
# ("Upper Silesia" is the seeded name for Opolskie).
# Sri Lanka — GeoNames "... Province" names are ambiguous token subsets of
# the seeded short names ("Western" ⊆ "North Western" etc.) — pin exactly.
# Spain / Iraq / Peru / DRC / Finland / Saudi Arabia / Qatar / Belarus —
# Italy / Kazakhstan / Malaysia / Bosnia / Egypt / Iran / Gambia.
# North Macedonia — GeoNames municipality codes vs seeded spellings.
# Sudan / Somalia / Mauritania / Yemen / Algeria / Guatemala / Cameroon /
# Estonia — GeoNames "-maa" county names vs seeded short forms.
